note: Questions and answers, kept as they were asked and answered. Each entry is dated and is the answer for that time. A later answer to the same question is a new entry, never an edit.

entries.question: Are we not at war but think we are?

paragraphs: That could be divided into quadrants: are / are not; think / think not. I was thinking at this stage it's we are and we think we are, a condition we rarely seem to meet. March through May arguable we were and thought we were but seemed to recalibrate and did not think we were even though we are. Now it seems to be aligning. If the reserves really are at the breaking point, then perhaps all this is leading to proof that oil exists. I guess that would be the strategic endgame. Once oil exists, everyone will act as if we're at war
